_doc: Maps TradingView / paper portfolio display names to mandate tier. Tier rules are enforced at placement time (tv-paper-trade / bus), not inside passesHighConvictionPick. Empty portfolios when no qualifying picks = correct behavior.

real_money.description: Must pass full HC filter as configured (all gates + consensus when independentGroupsMin > 0).

verified_test.description: Same trust/fwd/elite gates; optionally relax independent consensus (override via config when routing picks to these portfolios).

cash_sidelined.description: Do not auto-fill with low-quality signals; remain flat/cash until mandate changes.
